summaryZh: Cardiovascular Imaging Lab 的相关官方负责人页面介绍了用于心血管风险评估与治疗引导的成像研究。团队开发 MRI、CT 等方法，特别计划利用超低剂量 CT 血管造影识别心脏病高风险人群，以帮助选择治疗与预防策略。
researchQuestions: 如何用心血管成像识别心脏病高风险人群并指导治疗？
methods: 超低剂量 CT 血管造影

evidence.quote: UC San Diego - Cardiovascular Imaging Lab
McVeigh Lab Principal Investigator: Elliot McVeigh
Cardiovascular Imaging, MRI CT. Image guided therapy. Novel MRI and CT methods.
McVeigh and his team plan to develop ultra-low dose CT angiography techniques that will identify those people at substantially higher risk for heart disease.
